edits.new: The fragment's own layout is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-3094; ASM-5283). The composite route path, its merge order, the harness repository and SIT environment, the seeded data, the per-run evidence format and retention and the pass/fail gate are agreed by the platform edge story and the integration lead at the wave 2 entry check; until then they are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0396). The reason code, the rule ID and the package version of a move are kept in the local decision record; the deviation table takes no column for them (GAP-3096).
